title.narrative: Productive Organization for Women in Action

description.narrative: Productive Organization for Women in Action works to empower women and girls in Southern Belize to combat HIV, all forms of violence, stigma, discrimination and gender inequality. They do this by encouraging them to use their creativity and maximizing their potential through the facilitation of formal and informal education, provision of HIV/GBV services, and resource development for economic independence and self-actualization. They run initiatives that include information sessions that teach women about their human and legal rights, parenting techniques, entrepreneurial skills, and sessions that raise awareness of domestic and sexual violence. They also run the POWA Center, which serves as a safe place for community members to interact. The grant will support organizational costs, more specifically staff salaries.
